meta.description: Dedham movers for senior and downsizing moves: a calm pace, furniture placed where it fits and storage for what will not. Own crews. Free quote.

overview: Helping a parent leave a long-time Dedham home is a different kind of move. There are more decisions than boxes, and the new place is usually smaller.
Our crews work at the pace the day needs, place furniture where it fits and can store whatever does not.
sellingPoints: Furniture placed in the new rooms
Storage for pieces that do not fit

servicesBlock.h2: Senior and Downsizing Moves in Dedham
servicesBlock.intro: Senior moving is part of our residential service, and packing and storage often go with it. Some families split the furniture between the new home, relatives and storage; give us every address and the manager plans the day around them. Local and long distance options are both on the list below.

whyChoose.h2: Why Dedham Families Choose Us to Move a Parent

cards.title: Set Down Where It Belongs
cards.text: Each piece goes into the room and spot you choose in the smaller home, so nobody is shifting a dresser alone a week later.

cards.title: Storage for Extra Pieces
cards.text: Furniture that will not fit the new place can go into storage while the family decides what to keep. Nobody has to make every call in one weekend.

cards.title: Packing Done for Them
cards.text: Our crew can pack the house, which saves an older parent days of bending, lifting and taping boxes.

cards.title: Billing the Family Can Follow
cards.text: Local moves are billed hourly, with travel time from our yard added, and a manager explains the quote to whoever is organizing the move.

faqHeading: Questions About Moving a Parent From Dedham

faq.q: Can you move my mother from her Dedham house to a smaller apartment?
faq.a: Yes. Senior and downsizing moves are part of our residential work, and the crew places furniture in the new rooms as you direct.

faq.q: What happens to furniture that will not fit after a Dedham downsizing move?
faq.a: We can put it in storage until the family decides. Storage is priced by the cubic feet your items take up.

faq.q: Can I arrange my father's Dedham move from out of state?
faq.a: Yes. You can request the quote and handle the booking yourself; give us both addresses and a contact who will be on site for moving day.

faq.q: Will the crew pack my parent's Dedham home?
faq.a: Yes. We can pack the whole house or only the rooms that are moving, and the same crew loads it. Mark anything that stays behind so it is not boxed by mistake.

faq.q: Is there a minimum for a small Dedham downsizing move?
faq.a: Yes, a 2-hour minimum that includes travel time. Beyond that, the hourly rate runs only for the time the job takes.

faqClosing: More detail on deposits and payment is on the FAQ page.

closing.h2: Talk to Us About Moving a Parent in Dedham
closing.body: Share the move date, what is going to the new home and both addresses. A manager will price the move, plus storage if part of the furniture needs somewhere to wait. A floor plan or room sizes for the new place helps the family decide what fits before moving day.
